summary: American Battery Technology Company filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Bureau of Industry and Security export license permitting sale of up to $100 million of recycled black mass material under federal critical-mineral export controls. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or shareholder event is involved; the filing is an ordinary current report on a regulatory approval. The company cites over 400% year-over-year revenue growth and a second recycling facility backed by $150 million in DOE grants. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or deal mechanics apply. Watch operational execution and export-policy risk.
